title: Scarab Wall
wikitext:
{{Stub}}[[Image:The Scarab Wall.jpg|thumb|The Scarab Wall]]
'''The Scarab Wall''' lies at the southern edge of [[Silithus]], marking the boundary between the silithid-controlled desert and the ancient kingdom of [[Ahn'Qiraj]]. It is an impressive structure. 

There is a [[World Event]] to open the [[Gates of Ahn'Qiraj]].

See:
* [[Ahn'Qiraj]] for information on the area and lore
* [[Gates of Ahn'Qiraj]] for details on the massive quest to open those gates.
